dashboard.label: TA-rapl Overview
dashboard.description: Collects power telemetry from /sys/class/powercap (RAPL energy counters in microjoules, package/core domain limits) and, as a fallback, from hwmon power sensors (/sys/class/hwmon

panel.html: Commercial Use Commercial or production use of TA-rapl requires a paid license. Evaluation, personal, and lab use is free. See the BentleyPC Commercial License for full terms. Buy License License & Terms

search.query: | mstats avg("rapl.powercap_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("rapl.chip_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="rapl:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"power1_watts\":\s*(?<w>[0-9.]+)" | mvexpand w | stats sum(w) as value

index=main sourcetype="rapl:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"energy_uj\"") | spath input=o path=energy_uj | spath input=o path=max_energy_range_uj | spath input=o path=max_power_limit_uw | spath input=o path=min_power_limit_uw | table host k energy_uj max_energy_range_uj max_power_limit_uw min_power_limit_uw

index=main sourcetype="rapl:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"power1_watts\"") | spath input=o path=power1_watts | table host k power1_watts
